# hi-key

> hi-key is an iOS keyboard that generates AI images from text prompts. Users type a description in any app — iMessage, WhatsApp, Instagram, and more — and get 4 AI-generated images in seconds.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hi-key.ai/): Landing page with app overview, features, pricing, and download links
- [Privacy Policy](https://hi-key.ai/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://hi-key.ai/terms): Terms of service

## App

- [Waitlist](https://hi-key.ai/#waitlist): Join the waitlist to be notified when hi-key launches
